verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Fivetran syncing data to data warehouses and data lakes in open table formats. It never documents loading into vector stores or producing embeddings, chunks, or other LLM-ready formats. The 'unified context layer' line for AI tools is a vague tagline with no described vector or LLM-format destination, and unstructured file replication is an adjacent feature, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, pipelines load into vector stores and LLM-ready formats so my agents can retrieve what was synced
